title: Sorcery JJK
description: A customizable Jujutsu Kaisen Paper Plugin
body:
![Hollow Purple in shibuya, Map made by @Noshychan](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6eadfa1cd75449b48379ba0f5b2dc7963aa1789d.png) # Jujutsu Kaisen abilities, built entirely with a plugin. **Sorcery JJK** is a heavily optimized **Jujutsu Kaisen Minecraft plugin** built specifically for **Paper** servers.
The plugin works by using only the core plugin and a resource pack, which is automatically prompted when a player joins the server.
## Sorcery JJK's features This plugin adds **8 unique crystals**, all obtainable via the **/givecrystal** command. Each crystal grants its own unique abilities inspired by *Jujutsu Kaisen*, with a ton of customization using the configuration file and commands.
## New Jujutsu Kaisen Crystals Currently, there are **8 crystals** that allow players to use abilities from the beloved anime, such as **Hollow Purple** and **Malevolent Shrine**.
### Available Crystals (via **/givecrystal**): * Crystal of Infinity * Malevolent Crystal * Restless Gambler's Crystal * Judgement's Crystal * Vessel's Crystal * Crystal of Ten Shadows * Brother's Crystal * Heavenly Restricted Crystal
### Cursed Finger An additional item available through the **/givecrystal** command is the **Cursed Finger**. When consumed: * The player gains the ability to see any player who has used the **/sukuna** command. * If the player has either the **Vessel's Crystal** or the **Crystal of Ten Shadows**, they gain a special Sukuna-related ability. * This ability allows the player to temporarily hand over control of their body to a **random player** who has used the **/sukuna** command. > **Note:** It is recommended to have **only one Sukuna per server**, though this is not strictly required.

## A Brand New Special Grade System The plugin features a built-in progression loop inspired by the Jujutsu Society ranking system. Players start at the bottom and must earn their way up to becoming a Special Grade Sorcerer.
### Grade Progression & Unlocks * **Unlock Power:** Earning higher grades is the key to unlocking advanced, locked abilities tied to your crystals. * **Stat Scaling:** As players rank up, they naturally get stronger. Earning higher grades rewards players with extra max health (this feature can be completely toggled off in the configuration file if you prefer vanilla health values).
### How to Earn and Lose Points * **Extermination:** Players earn points by hunting down and killing enemy mobs and monsters across the world. * **Jujutsu High Competitiveness:** Points are completely volatile. Sorcerers can directly **steal points from other players by killing them in PvP**, making your server highly competitive and rewarding bounty hunting. * **Point Economy:** Earning too many points? Players can use the **/withdrawpoints** command to safely store their progression points into physical items to trade, hoard, or save for later.

## Sorcery JJK Commands **/sukuna**
Adds the player to the Sukuna list, makes them invisible, and disables their PvP. **/unsukuna**
Removes the player from the Sukuna list. **/unpossess**
Used by Sukuna players to unpossess their current victim. This command will not work if the victim is offline. **/givecrystal**
Gives the player one of the available crystals. **/disabledomains**
Simply disables the domains on the server. Does not transfer between sessions. **/grade **
Sets the player's points in the grade system. Will also unlock locked abilities **/bindcrystal**
Binds the player with one of the available crystals (can't be dropped or stored) **/withdrawpoints**
Simply withdraws points into a item. **/disableabilities **
Disables abilities for the provided player. **/infinity**
Grants the command user invincibility
## Plugin Permissions **sorcery.sukuna**
Allows marking a player as Sukuna. **sorcery.unsukuna**
Allows removing a player from the Sukuna list. **sorcery.unpossess**
Allows releasing a possessed player. Currently, this permission is mostly redundant, as any player possessing someone can use the command. **sorcery.givecrystal**
Allows giving custom crystals. **sorcery.bindcrystal**
Allows binding custom crystals. **sorcery.points.withdraw**
Allows withdrawing of crystals. **sorcery.infinity**
Allows use of the "infinity" command. **sorcery.disabledomains**
Allows disabling domains. **sorcery.grade.use**
Allows usage of the /grade command (required for /grade see). **sorcery.grade**
Allows managing player grades and points (set/increase). **sorcery.grade.see.others**
Allows viewing other players points and grades.

## Bugs and glitches Report bugs and glitches with the plugin through the discord server: https://discord.gg/QjH5gK7mP9
### Note: If your server hosting provider blocks the resource pack from going through, you have to set it manually in server.properties as a required resource pack through this link: https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/sorceryjjk
